title: Designer / Draftsperson
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a draftsperson?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Are you willing to undergo pre-employment drug and alcohol screening?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95137066). Company also notes careers pathway; formal route is SEEK.
rationale: Entry-friendly Designer/Draftsperson in Melbourne with Revit and AutoCAD essential; Marc has AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit from Advanced Diploma coursework.
Advert welcomes recent graduates and career changers and accepts a valid Australian work visa; Marc holds Subclass 485 rights to December 2027.
Civil drafting experience listed as acceptable background; fire protection is taught on the job so the honest limit is no fire-protection drafting yet.
caution: Role is fire-protection documentation, not civil roads or earthworks. Revit proficiency is essential; Marc's Revit is coursework-level.
gaps: No fire-protection drafting experience yet (employer trains)
Revit experience is academic rather than production
employer_line: Entire's Fire Protection team in South Melbourne turns briefs into technical documentation for fire systems on Melbourne building projects and trains new designers in the standards.
